name: Jörmungandr Haqua
original_name: ヨルムンガンド・ハクア
source:
"I'm still half-fledged."

The daughter of the being that's trying to take over the galaxy, Astaroth.
Her range of emotions is very narrow.
She's trying to get the Lizard Stone that Marco stole.
